data.description: 家中矮桌，她盘腿坐着核对家计簿，计算器、超市传单和笔袋一字排开；发现本月结余比预期多时，嘴角忍不住上扬，又立刻收敛成「理所当然」的表情。
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane sits cross-legged at the low table, checking the household ledger with a calculator, supermarket flyers and pencil case arranged beside it. Her cream pullover and navy lounge trousers remain comfortable as an unexpected surplus draws a brief smile. The horizontal medium view includes the table edge and small home interior behind. Afternoon light falls across figures and her sleeves, with soft shadows beneath the calculator and her resting hand.
data.title: 白银圭 · 白银家的家计簿
